QuestInfo.name: What Did You Do Now
QuestInfo.0: Moonbeam seems very angry for some reason. Catch up to Moonbeam and comfort her.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam seems very angry for some reason. Catch up to Moonbeam and comfort her.
QuestInfo.2: After a lapse in consciousness, you awake to see Moonbeam looking relieved. Soon after, she became very angry and left. It seems like she was frustrated to see you get hurt after going out to get a thank-you gift. Moonbeam shared her power with you, saying you're so weak that you'd die without it. You planned on leaving the village after regaining your powers, and you're not sure why this child is doing this much for you.
